# TERMs with `line` `readiness`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**Readiness and slack** — what it takes to keep, reach and pay for capacities whose value lies in rare circumstances — readiness as response capability, slack and reconfiguration slack as different reserves, the resource threshold of a transition and its obstructions, and budget rules that remove options no one chose to give up (ADR-073).

| [TERM-106](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-106.md) | reconfiguration slack: the temporary resources a system needs to move between two configurations it can each hold, beyond what holding either one requires, while keeping specified commitments | A's proposal, from the pasted synthesis on constraint architectures (pasted by the owner on 2026-11-04, continuing the exchange on emergency readiness whose share link could not be fetched), Part 4. Made exact here as the gap between the bottleneck budget of a transition and the larger of its endpoints' holding requirements, infinite when no admissible path joins them.
